# Open Book Inside Headphones — reference review

- source: `pictographic-primitives/_uncategorized_04/audio book headphones_b0fa3cc1-6e0c-4af2-b4ad-57175c266a2a.svg`
- source UUID: `b0fa3cc1-6e0c-4af2-b4ad-57175c266a2a`
- classification: container_combination
- review: component_briefs_ready

The headphone band and earcups form a recognizable enclosure around an independent open-book glyph; no head or reader physically wears the headphones.

## Visual draft

A broad headphone arch surrounds an open book with two curved pages and a central fold. Rounded earcups sit outside the book on both sides of the arch.

## 1. Empty headphone enclosure (container)

A broad arched headphone band ends in two rounded outward-facing earcups. Leave the space between the earcups empty and exclude the open book.

## 2. Open book glyph (sub)

An open book has two broad curved page faces meeting at a vertical central fold and a pointed lower junction. Exclude the surrounding headphones and earcups.
